evidence.detail: Reviewed KeyRemappingPlugin rs/s/j/c stores rs/s/j/b as its key listener and registers/unregisters that exact instance with the client key-listener manager during plugin startup/shutdown.
rs/s/j/b implements the client key-listener interface rs/g/a/a and defines only keyTyped, keyPressed and keyReleased entry points plus private helpers for the same keyboard flow.
When the reviewed KeyRemappingConfig camera-remapping option is enabled, configured W/S/A/D-style Keybind values are translated to the arrow-key codes UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT before the event continues.

When reviewed F-key remapping is enabled, configured keybinds are translated to F1 through F12 key codes. The listener records original-to-remapped key codes and restores the remapped code on keyReleased, while suppressing the original typed character when necessary.

The same listener owns the KeyRemappingPlugin keyboard path for entering/leaving the plugin-managed chat state: Enter/Escape/Backspace and slash/semicolon handling delegate into the reviewed plugin's Press Enter to Chat state rather than an unrelated subsystem.

candidates.note: KeyRemappingKeyListener is fixed by exclusive KeyRemappingPlugin registration, the client key-listener interface, exact camera/F-key substitution and release restoration, plus the same plugin's chat-key state handling. Confidence is 0.999.
